quote: You will carry sorrow like an old coat. Nobody warned you how heavy it gets. You walk through rooms filled with fading light. You try to remember the sound of laughter. Every shadow remembers what you are trying to forget. Time does not heal every single open wound. It only teaches you how to carry the weight.
